text:
maria_ops: Quick sync — proposing a short playbook for inbound lead ACCEPTANCE SLA. idea: 30m for owner to Accept claim after enrichment completes, then 2h to make first outreach. wants to reduce leak to 'unowned' queue.

aj_growth: 30m sounds reasonable for PLG-style leads. what's the trigger exactly? enrichment finished or hubspot assignment?

maria_ops: Trigger = enrichment complete + owner assignment event from HubSpot. we currently mark owner at `hs_owner_id` on enrichment completion, but acceptance isn't tracked. proposal adds `owner_acceptance_deadline` and heartbeat tasks.

ben_salesops: Can we do this fully in HubSpot workflows? i'm worried about race with Salesforce lead conversion and our existing RR rules.

nina_revops: HubSpot workflows + a small middleware (lambda) is safest. workflow sets a task & custom property `acceptance_deadline_ts`, then our middleware watches and escalates if not accepted by deadline. falls back to overflow pool.

oliver_sdr: from ops side — we need a clear UI for SDRs to Accept vs Claim. right now claim often auto-assigns and folks don't notice. an explicit "Accept lead" task would help.

maria_ops: Exactly. UX: task shows "Accept 30m" with CTA to Accept or Snooze (15m). If Snooze hit twice, escalate to overflow.

hubspot-bot: Workflow event created: "Inbound Enrichment Complete" -> set property `acceptance_deadline_ts` = now + 1800s; create task "Accept lead (30m)" assigned to owner.

ben_salesops: Need to ensure Salesforce sync doesn't clobber acceptance state. suggestion: write `acceptance_status` to HS only; SF sync ignores that property. i'll add mapping rule.

nina_revops: Pseudocode for middleware watcher (very small):
```
poll leads where acceptance_status = "pending" and acceptance_deadline_ts < now
  if owner has not clicked Accept:
    escalate: add to overflow rotation, notify salesops channel, create follow-up task
```

aj_growth: what about round-robin fixes? if owner is in a disabled state (OOO) we should detect and skip on assignment. this should be part of the assignment rule upstream.

maria_ops: we'll add a pre-assign check: if owner.status in (OOO, disabled, unsubscribed) -> route to next RR candidate. that reduces bounce and speeds acceptance.

oliver_sdr: can we get a heartbeat for assigned leads so managers can see acceptance SLAs in Console? a simple tag `accepted_at` would do.

ben_salesops: ok action items: 1) ben: add SF mapping to ignore `acceptance_*` fields (ETA Tue) 2) maria: update HubSpot workflow + task copy (ETA Mon) 3) nina: prototype middleware watcher (ETA Wed) 4) aj: audit RR pre-assign filters for OOO detection (ETA Tue) 5) oliver: get SDR feedback on Accept vs Claim wording (ETA Tue).

maria_ops: i'll draft the HS task copy here to review: "Accept this lead — respond within 30 minutes. Click Accept to confirm ownership or Snooze for 15 minutes. If unaccepted, lead will be routed to overflow pool." thoughts?

oliver_sdr: wording good. maybe change 'Snooze' -> 'Remind me (15m)'. less button-y.

ben_salesops: fine. also add an internal tag `acceptance_missed` so we can build a dashboard.

nina_revops: Metrics to track: percent accepted within 30m, time-to-first-outreach, overflow rate, and SLA misses by owner/team. will add to weekly marketing->sales dashboard.

aj_growth: minor edge-case: enrichment TTL. some enrichments take >2 min. make acceptance deadline relative to enrichment completion event, not enrichment start.

maria_ops: yes that's in the plan. final note: rollout plan — pilot to APAC SDR team for 2 weeks, monitor, then roll global. volunteer testers? @oliver_sdr? :thumbsup:

oliver_sdr: i'll run pilot with my team. we'll collect feedback and sample tasks.

maria_ops: thanks everyone — i'll update the playbook doc and ping here when HS workflow is pushed. :sparkles:

ben_salesops: tagging follow-up in #marketing for visibility and will create a short KB article for SDRs post-rollout.
